title: Trend arrow on wear (SW3) does not budge
body:
No matter how steep the delta, the trend arrow on both the xDrip watchface and the xDrip large watchface on my Sony SW3 remains level. 

- Version: nightlies between Jan 01 2018 and Jan 18 2018
- Hardware Data Source: 640G/Evernsense
- Upload: mongoDB
- Smooth sensor noise on
- Wear Integration: on, Show Treatments activated
- Smartwatch sensors on (stepcounter works like a charm!)

Other SW running/communicating via xDrip broadcast: 600series uploader, AndroidAPS

Images: xDrip watchface, AAPSv2 watchface of the same timespan as reference.
![xdrip02](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/35570803/35116768-da336ce0-fc8c-11e7-908e-8fc88d438291.png)
![aaps04](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/35570803/35116797-ee66eda4-fc8c-11e7-9906-ac84629225cc.png)

My heartfelt thanks to everyone involved in creating this incredible piece of software - the entire ecosystem is a true life-changer! Still learning... Tatjana

I bought a Sony Smartwatch 3 recently and configured it to work with my xdrip+ (version f20d8da-2018.05.30 with Hardware data source: 640G/Eversense) and 600seriesuploader on my phone.
Trend arrow on watchface is always horizontal no matter which delta value is been displayed.
It would be great if the arrow could change according to delta values to provide us with fast visual info of our BG trend.
